description: Source-backed contract for FOnline audio resource delivery, decoding, playback, mixing, script entry points, and validation boundaries.

scope.support_note: The three current decoders and client playback behavior are revision-pinned while focused native decoder fixtures and a versioned compatibility policy are still missing.
included: WAV, ACM, and Ogg Vorbis resource formats accepted by the stock client
RawCopyBaker delivery and ResourceManager sound-name indexing
SoundManager decoding, conversion, streaming, mixing, repeat, and stop behavior
Game.PlaySound and Game.PlayMusic client script entry points
Audio settings, headless behavior, diagnostics, and project validation boundaries
excluded: project sound catalogs, path conventions, music state machines, ambient selection, and spatialization policy
recording, voice chat, capture devices, DSP graphs, buses, ducking, and per-source gain
audio mastering targets, loudness policy, licensing, attribution, and source provenance
Effekseer sound nodes, which are not supported by the FOnline Effekseer runtime

formats.name: PCM WAV
formats.role: Short effects or music decoded fully before playback
formats.requirement: Use a RIFF/WAVE file with an immediate fmt chunk, optional fact chunk, an immediate data chunk, PCM format tag 1, and 8-bit unsigned or 16-bit signed samples.
formats.rationale: The stock loader is deliberately narrower than the general WAV family and rejects compression, unsupported sample widths, and unexpected chunk order.

formats.name: Legacy Fallout ACM
formats.role: Legacy effects and music decoded fully before playback
formats.requirement: Supply an Interplay ACM stream accepted by CACMUnpacker; the stock playback contract treats effects as mono and music as stereo signed 16-bit audio at 22050 Hz.
formats.rationale: ACM compatibility exists for classic Fallout assets, but its playback shape is fixed by SoundManager instead of inferred from a modern container.

formats.name: Ogg Vorbis
formats.requirement: Use an Ogg bitstream containing Vorbis audio; SoundManager decodes signed 16-bit interleaved data and retains the decoder only when more than the first chunk remains.
formats.rationale: The implementation uses libvorbisfile callbacks over the engine FileSystem and does not provide a generic Ogg-codec dispatch layer.

delivery_rules.name: Raw-copy delivery
delivery_rules.requirement: Keep acm, ogg, and wav in Baking.RawCopyFileExtensions and include RawCopy in every resource pack that owns runtime audio.
delivery_rules.rationale: There is no dedicated audio baker; runtime decoders require the original bytes and relative path.

delivery_rules.name: Client sound index
delivery_rules.requirement: Call ResourceManager.IndexFiles after client resources are available; it indexes every wav, acm, and ogg path for effect-name lookup.
delivery_rules.rationale: Game.PlaySound resolves through the prebuilt name map rather than scanning the filesystem on each call.

delivery_rules.name: Effect identity
delivery_rules.requirement: Treat an effect identity as the lowercase resource path with its final extension removed.
delivery_rules.rationale: PlaySound erases the caller suffix and lowercases the name before querying ResourceManager's identically normalized index.

delivery_rules.name: Duplicate-stem precedence
delivery_rules.requirement: Do not ship multiple wav/acm/ogg resources with the same normalized effect stem; when they collide, the first indexed extension wins in wav, acm, ogg order.
delivery_rules.rationale: ResourceManager uses map::emplace while iterating the fixed extension array, so later formats do not replace an existing stem.

delivery_rules.name: Music path ownership
delivery_rules.requirement: Pass music as an exact resource path; unlike effects, music is not resolved through the normalized sound-name index.
delivery_rules.rationale: PlayMusic forwards the supplied filename directly to SoundManager.Load.

decoding_rules.name: WAV chunk order
decoding_rules.requirement: Place RIFF, WAVE, fmt, optional fact, and data in the exact order expected by LoadWav.
decoding_rules.rationale: The loader is a focused sequential reader, not a general RIFF chunk walker.

decoding_rules.name: WAV PCM widths
decoding_rules.requirement: Author WAV as uncompressed PCM with either 8-bit unsigned or 16-bit signed samples; channel count and sample rate may vary and are converted by the frontend.
decoding_rules.rationale: LoadWav maps only those two widths to AppAudio formats before device conversion.

decoding_rules.name: ACM playback shape
decoding_rules.requirement: Expect ACM effects to decode as mono and ACM music as stereo signed 16-bit samples at 22050 Hz.
decoding_rules.rationale: These values are assigned by playback role after CACMUnpacker runs.

decoding_rules.name: Ogg streaming
decoding_rules.requirement: Expect Ogg Vorbis to decode in 64 KiB native chunks and 128 KiB Web chunks; short files are retained fully and release the stream after the initial decode.
decoding_rules.rationale: SoundManager uses a platform-sized streaming portion and clears OggStream when the first read reaches EOF.

decoding_rules.name: Device conversion
decoding_rules.requirement: Let AppAudio convert decoded sample format, channel count, and rate to the active SDL output-device format before playback.
decoding_rules.rationale: SoundManager does not require authored assets to match one fixed hardware format.

decoding_rules.name: Audio callback mixing
decoding_rules.requirement: Treat playback as client audio-callback work; mutations of the active sound list must hold the audio-device lock.
decoding_rules.rationale: The SDL stream callback asks SoundManager to fill output while game-thread play/stop operations can add or erase sounds.

decoding_rules.name: Unsupported extension limitation
decoding_rules.requirement: Author only wav, acm, or ogg paths. The current loader has no fallback rejection branch, so another explicit suffix bypasses all decoders and can enqueue an empty sound while returning success.
decoding_rules.rationale: This is a documented implementation limitation, not support for arbitrary audio formats; callers and content validation must keep unsupported suffixes out.

playback_rules.name: Game.PlaySound
playback_rules.requirement: Use Game.PlaySound on the client for non-music playback and inspect its bool result when audio is active and SoundVolume is nonzero.
playback_rules.rationale: The script method delegates to SoundManager.PlaySound with the indexed resource-name map.

playback_rules.name: Base effect before variants
playback_rules.requirement: If the normalized base effect exists, play it directly and do not select numbered alternatives.
playback_rules.rationale: Variant discovery runs only after the base lookup misses.

playback_rules.name: Contiguous numbered variants
playback_rules.requirement: To randomize an absent base effect, provide a contiguous one-based sequence NAME_1 through NAME_N; discovery stops at the first missing suffix.
playback_rules.rationale: SoundManager counts consecutive map hits and chooses uniformly from 1 through count.

playback_rules.name: No stock spatial source
playback_rules.requirement: Treat every SoundManager sound as a global client mix input; implement listener selection, distance policy, or recipient filtering in project code.
playback_rules.rationale: The stock playback object has no world position, radius, pan, or per-instance volume field.

playback_rules.name: Game.PlayMusic
playback_rules.requirement: Use Game.PlayMusic with an exact resource path and repeat interval; an empty path stops current music and succeeds.
playback_rules.rationale: The script entry point owns the empty-name stop convention before delegating to SoundManager.

playback_rules.name: Single music stream
playback_rules.requirement: Expect a new music request to stop every existing music instance before attempting to load the replacement.
playback_rules.rationale: SoundManager.PlayMusic calls StopMusic before Load, so a failed replacement does not restore the previous track.

playback_rules.name: Repeat interval
playback_rules.requirement: Pass a nonzero repeatTime to replay after completion; values at or below one millisecond repeat immediately, and larger values insert that delay.
playback_rules.rationale: ProcessSound schedules NextPlayTime using a one-millisecond threshold and rewinds retained Ogg streams before replay.

playback_rules.name: Sound and music volumes
playback_rules.requirement: Control effects with Audio.SoundVolume and music with Audio.MusicVolume; the frontend clamps each mix operation to 0 through 100.
playback_rules.rationale: SoundManager selects a volume by IsMusic and AppAudio normalizes the clamped percentage before SDL mixing.

playback_rules.name: Disabled audio return convention
playback_rules.requirement: Do not use a true PlaySound or PlayMusic result as resource-existence proof when audio is disabled, unavailable, or effect volume is zero.
playback_rules.rationale: Inactive playback and zero effect volume intentionally return success without loading a resource.

playback_rules.name: Missing extension fallback
playback_rules.requirement: An exact music path without an extension receives .acm; effect lookup ignores the caller extension and resolves by indexed stem.
playback_rules.rationale: The default extension belongs to SoundManager.Load, while PlaySound normalizes before Load.

validation_rules.name: Source-backed reference
validation_rules.requirement: Regenerate and check the audio model whenever SoundManager, ResourceManager, AppAudio, settings, raw-copy delivery, or script entry points change.
validation_rules.rationale: The generated model rejects extension, decoder, chunk-size, default, setting, and headless drift before prose can silently become stale.

anchors: ResourceManager index extensions and SoundManager dispatch extensions differ

validation_rules.name: Baking gate
validation_rules.requirement: Bake a pack containing representative audio and verify the expected relative paths and original bytes reach client resources.
validation_rules.rationale: Documentation checks can prove configured extension coverage but cannot prove an embedding project's resource-pack wiring.

validation_rules.name: Decoder diagnostics
validation_rules.requirement: Treat false playback results and RIFF, PCM, ACM, Ogg, or conversion log lines as authoring failures; reject unsupported suffixes in content validation because the runtime currently has no diagnostic for them.
validation_rules.rationale: The loaders report format-specific failure boundaries instead of substituting silence as a valid resource.

validation_rules.name: Headless boundary
validation_rules.requirement: Do not claim audible validation from a headless or stub application; AppAudio is disabled there and playback may report no-op success.
validation_rules.rationale: Headless audio deliberately exposes no active device or callback.

validation_rules.name: Focused native test gap
validation_rules.requirement: Keep the absence of focused SoundManager decoder/playback fixtures visible until tests cover valid and invalid WAV, ACM, Ogg, variant, repeat, and replacement behavior.
validation_rules.rationale: RawCopyBaker and broad client tests do not execute the codec and callback contract documented here.

validation_rules.name: Visible audible validation
validation_rules.requirement: On every claimed platform, use a visible client with audio enabled to play one asset per format, a numbered effect family, a replacement track, delayed and immediate repeats, and volume endpoints.
validation_rules.rationale: Only an active platform audio device can prove conversion, callback scheduling, mixing, and audible output.

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project ownership
validation_rules.requirement: Keep catalog conventions, spatial/recipient policy, mastering, licenses, attribution, budgets, and gameplay triggers in project documentation and tests.
validation_rules.rationale: The engine supplies decoding and a global client mixer, not a complete game audio design or asset-governance system.
